summary: Exception 'what()'-style getter (__thiscall): returns the string pointer stored at this+0x4 when non-null, otherwise returns the global 'Unknown exception' fallback string (0x005B9DC8).

operations.description: Read this+0x4 (const char*). If it is null, return the global 'Unknown exception' string at 0x005B9DC8.
When this+0x4 is non-null, return it as the exception message string pointer.

unresolved: Owning class of 'this' is unidentified; field at +0x4 is read-only here.
Whether the global string at 0x005B9DC8 is an owned static or a shared literal is not evidenced.
